summary: A return site that credits an account later serves a different need from a counter that pays a visitor on the spot.
realLife: In its 2023 amendment to Maine LD 1909, the committee proposed a geographic distribution of return options that included immediate refunds as well as payments made within a specified interval after drop-off.
gates: A service plan counts an immediate-payment counter and a delayed-payment depot.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: a service plan counts an immediate-payment counter and a delayed-payment depot.

turns.what: The planner checks the route to the immediate-payment counter.
turns.pulledBy: A resident needs the refund for today's shopping.
turns.writesBack: The access review records which option meets that need.

turns.what: The nearby depot can meet the need.
turns.pulledBy: The resident can wait for account credit.
turns.writesBack: The mapped service area identifies the payment interval.
